headline: See your business clearly. Automate the work that slows you down.
subheadline: Lynxcom Analytics helps businesses transform scattered spreadsheets, manual reports and repetitive tasks into secure dashboards, reporting systems and practical automation workflows.

services.title: Executive dashboards
services.body: Clean KPI dashboards for sales, customers, revenue, staff, inventory, projects and operational performance.

services.title: Reporting systems
services.body: Daily, weekly and monthly reporting structures that show what improved, what dropped and what requires action.

services.title: Data cleanup & structure
services.body: We clean messy Excel/CSV/Google Sheets records, remove duplicates and prepare data for reliable decision-making.

services.title: AI workflow audit
services.body: We review repetitive admin, reporting and follow-up tasks to identify where AI and automation can save time.

services.title: Workflow automation planning
services.body: We design practical workflows for reminders, forms, reports, customer follow-up, email/SMS/WhatsApp sequences and alerts.

services.title: Management action system
services.body: We turn reports into next actions: who to call, what to fix, where the business is leaking value and what to do next.
